entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: A species of biomechanical monstrosities that infect and convert others into more of their kind through compleation.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The first world of the Phyrexians, created by Yawgmoth.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane formerly Mirrodin, infected by glistening oil and renamed by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The process by which Phyrexians infect and convert others into more of their kind.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Thran eugenicist who believed beings should be made perfect through artifice and who created the first Phyrexia; his death caused the hivemind to cease functioning.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: Figure thanks to whom Yawgmoth took over an initially idyllic world.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Figure whom the pneumagogs pursued to join the Phyrexian cause.

entities.name: Pneumagogs
entities.description: The most perfect Phyrexian lifeforms, Yawgmoth's angel-like creations.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Created the artificial Argentum and accidentally left behind a drop of glistening oil.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: First corrupted by the oil, leading to the creation of the mycosynth.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: The oil that infects planes and compleates beings; charged by Mirrodin's five suns.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: White-aligned Phyrexian praetor who subdued the other factions and led the Alabaster Host.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Praetor who commands the Chrome Host.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Praetor whose execution left the Etched Host divided among thanes.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Praetor who refused to take part in the invasion, leaving the Furnace Host leaderless.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Praetor commanding the Copper Host.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The 4562 AR invasion of the multiverse by the Machine Legion.

entities.name: Machine Legion
entities.description: The New Phyrexian invasion force, split into five hosts.

entities.name: Alabaster Host
entities.description: The bulk of the invading force, led directly by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Chrome Host
entities.description: Host commanded by Jin-Gitaxias to gather information across the Multiverse.

entities.name: Etched Host
entities.description: The most vicious host, divided among the thanes after Sheoldred's execution.

entities.name: Furnace Host
entities.description: Host led by no one because of Urabrask's refusal, turned loose by Norn.

entities.name: Copper Host
entities.description: Host under Vorinclex which tests potential new Phyrexians.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Plane swapped with New Phyrexia in the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Vicious Swarm
entities.description: A green-aligned Phyrexian group, the notable exception to non-sexual reproduction.

events.summary: Yawgmoth, a Thran eugenicist, takes over an idyllic world with Dyfed's help and brings his followers there, creating the first Phyrexia.
events.quote: he brought his followers to this new world, the first Phyrexia

events.summary: Yawgmoth dies and the Phyrexian hivemind ceases to function, at least temporarily.
events.quote: This first happened with Yawgmoth 's death and later with Elesh Norn 's.

events.summary: The pneumagogs pursue Urza to join the Phyrexian cause.
events.quote: they pursued Urza to join the Phyrexian cause

events.summary: Karn creates Argentum and accidentally leaves a drop of glistening oil, which corrupts Memnarch and creates the mycosynth.
events.quote: he accidentally left behind a drop of glistening oil on the plane

events.summary: Phyrexian influence spreads until only pockets of Mirran Resistance remain, and the plane is renamed New Phyrexia.
events.quote: the phyrexians renamed it New Phyrexia

events.summary: The new Phyrexians split into five factions, each led by a praetor, and Elesh Norn's white-aligned faction subdues the rest and becomes Mother of Machines.
events.quote: managed to subdue the other factions and install her as Mother of Machines

events.summary: In 4562 AR the New Phyrexian Invasion occurs; New Phyrexia is swapped with Zhalfir, cutting off the oil's contact and rendering it inert.
events.quote: New Phyrexia was swapped with Zhalfir in the blind eternities

events.summary: Furnace Host is turned loose on the Multiverse because Urabrask refuses to participate.
events.quote: Urabrask's refusal to participate in the invasion

relations.quote: The creation of Phyrexia started with Yawgmoth
The Alabaster Host is led directly by Elesh Norn
The Chrome Host ( , 32 cards ) is commanded by Jin-Gitaxias.

relations.note: First praetor to align with Norn.
relations.quote: As the first praetor to align with Elesh Norn

relations.note: Karn created the artificial Argentum, later Mirrodin and then New Phyrexia.
relations.quote: When Karn created the artificial Argentum
was split up into five factions
